objective: Find one mechanism-new, corpus-screened path to a fully charged prime-field ECDLP exponent below one half and subject it to independent falsification before experiment design.

tasks.title: Generate a mechanism-new cryptographic ECDLP candidate

handoff.objective: Produce one genuinely mechanism-new, falsifiable path to a fully charged prime-field ECDLP exponent below one half.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether any unclosed non-generic representation supplies complete relations, source recovery, factor logs, and blind descent below rho.
inputs: The persistent goal and broad cryptographic research question
The complete knowledge index, negative corpus, and current focus plan
constraints: Separate established facts, speculation, derivation, and proposed tests.
Deduplicate against the full corpus and reject backend-only substitutions.
Include complete ECDLP accounting and one cheapest decisive falsification gate.
Make no breakthrough claim and change no official state.
completion_gate: The candidate is explicitly deduplicated against the corpus.
The mechanism includes relation supply, source recovery, factor logs, descent, and a rho comparison.
One bounded next experiment or derivation can falsify its central claim.

handoff.objective: Commit and verify the exact idea-generator artifacts before review.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the reviewed proposal is bound to an immutable snapshot.
constraints: Run alone and stage only declared paths.
completion_gate: Git verifies the exact parent, paths, hashes, task ID, and reachable commit.

handoff.objective: Independently falsify the candidate's novelty, oracle model, asymptotic accounting, source completeness, and cryptographic path.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the candidate survives known lower bounds, prior negatives, hidden preprocessing, supplied witnesses, and incomplete ECDLP accounting.
inputs: The immutable producer snapshot and complete internal corpus
constraints: Preserve exact scope and distinguish absence of construction from impossibility.
Require a cheaper decisive gate before any large run.
Change no producer artifact or official state.
completion_gate: Every claimed exponent and oracle is independently reconstructed.
The verdict names the narrowest surviving uncertainty and next gate.

handoff.objective: Archive the review, theory evidence, scoped batch decision, and persistent-goal checkpoint.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether BATCH-001 yields an admissible experiment-design action.
inputs: The independent red-team artifacts and verified producer snapshot
constraints: Only the Coordinator may write official records.
Do not upgrade theory review to empirical or cryptographic evidence.
Record exactly one next action and a knowledge-promotion disposition.
completion_gate: Evidence, decision, and goal records validate and preserve theory-only scope.
The verified ledger commit records exactly one next action.
